name: com.setsuodu.localization
description: Pure Excel-driven localization core for Unity. No ScriptableObject. Key-based. Binary hot-update friendly. UI bindings provided as Samples. Includes click-to-switch language demo.

samples.description: LocText + LocDemo: click language buttons to switch title/button/Label texts in real-time.
LocLabel VisualElement for UI Toolkit, with sample CSV.
